title: anthomeles sanguinea
intro: Anthomeles sanguinea, commonly known as Chinese Angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to China and other parts of Asia. Chinese Angelica has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Angelica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiplatelet effects, which may help to lower blood pressure and prevent blood clots. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Angelica include volatile oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
